remarks: Set on over 5 private acres just outside the Village of Ellicottville, this 4-bedroom, 4-bath chalet delivers the balance buyers are looking for—privacy when you want it, and immediate access to everything that makes this area one of Western New York’s premier four-season destinations. Inside, the home is anchored by a dramatic great room with soaring vaulted wood ceilings and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, creating a true lodge feel that opens seamlessly into the kitchen and dining area—ideal for entertaining after a day on the slopes or hosting a full house for the weekend. The main-level primary suite offers convenience and comfort, while additional bedrooms and flexible living space upstairs and in the finished lower level provide room for guests or rental potential. The lower level adds a second gathering space with room for games and relaxation, making this home as functional as it is inviting. Step outside and the setting takes over—an expansive deck overlooks rolling acreage and a private stocked pond, offering year-round enjoyment from summer evenings by the water to crisp fall mornings and winter snow-covered views. Located just minutes to both Holiday Valley and HoliMont, along with Ellicottville’s shops, restaurants, festivals, and nightlife, you are never far from skiing, golf, mountain biking, hiking, and all the energy the village brings in every season. Whether it’s a primary residence, weekend retreat, or investment property, this home checks every box with space, setting, and location—delivering the full Ellicottville lifestyle in one complete package.
